scope: Conditional simultaneous uncertainty over exactly the already registered 49-point block grid; no new weights, candidates, model fits, audit data or release selection.
motivation: Do not use the incumbent-v2 standard error for a different small reweighting contrast. Estimate each contrast's paired uncertainty and their joint dependence.
method: Exact positive/negative AUC placements for the incumbent and each fixed grid score; covariance of paired placement differences. Draw a zero-mean multivariate Gaussian with that estimated covariance. Use the 95th percentile of maximum absolute standardized perturbation for an approximate simultaneous fixed-grid band.
extra_outputs: Contrast-specific standard errors and conditional pointwise intervals for every existing grid point
Simultaneous fixed-grid interval endpoints and their critical value
Which existing grid point maximizes observed AUC plus each Gaussian perturbation, labeled perturbation selection frequency rather than probability of being the true optimum
prohibited_claims: This cannot account for historical model/anchor/recipe selection, training variance, cross-fold training dependence or distribution shift. It is not an independent generalization estimate, Bayesian posterior, exact finite-sample confidence band, new release gate or license to select another submission.
resource_limit: CPU only, at most two numerical threads and 2 GiB planned extra arrays. No precision refinement or additional weight grid.
